user.title: Connect to the Somfy UAI+
user.description: Enter the address and telnet credentials of your Somfy Connect UAI+ gateway. Motors and groups are discovered automatically.

data_description.web_password: A different credential from the telnet one above -- it is the password for the gateway's own web page. Without it, motors that cannot report position over telnet (Irismo behind an SDN bridge) will show no open/closed state.

confirm.title: Confirm discovered devices
confirm.description:
Found {motors} motor(s) on {host}: {positional} report position, {non_positional} are open/close/stop only (for example Irismo motors behind an SDN bridge). {groups} group(s) detected.

Motor entities are created but disabled by default so they do not add state updates until you need them. Group entities are enabled.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the gateway. Check the host and port.
error.no_motors: Connected, but the gateway reported no motors.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

polling.title: Polling
polling.description: How often to poll motors that report position. Motors without position feedback are never polled.

capability.title: Motor capability
capability.description:
Correct a motor whose capability was detected wrongly.

Capability is normally read from the motor type the gateway reports, so this is only needed for hardware this integration does not recognise. Changing it reloads the integration.

motor.title: Capability
motor.description:
{motor}

Automatic uses the type the gateway reports. Reports position adds the position slider and starts polling this motor. No position feedback removes the slider and stops polling it.

web.title: Web interface password
web.description:
Currently {state}.

The gateway's web page has its own password, separate from the telnet one. It is what lets this integration read open/closed state for motors without position feedback, such as Irismo behind an SDN bridge.

Leave the box empty to clear it and turn that off.

abort.no_motors: No motors are loaded for this gateway yet. Try again once the integration has finished starting.
